title.zh: 将曼达卢永市 Pleasant Hills 描笼涯一所小学的附属校分离，改设为独立的 Pleasant Hills 小学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Nuevo de Febrero Elementary School-Pleasant Hills Annex in Barangay Pleasant Hills, City of Mandaluyong from the Nuevo de Febrero Elementary School, Converting it into an Independent Elementary School to Be Known as the Pleasant Hills Elementary School and Appropriating Funds therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Nuevo de Febrero Elementary School-Pleasant Hills Annex in Barangay Pleasant Hills, City of Mandaluyong from the Nuevo de Febrero Elementary School, Converting it into an Independent Elementary School to Be Known as the Pleasant Hills Elementary School and Appropriating Funds therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Pleasant Hills của Trường Tiểu học Nuevo de Febrero tại Barangay Pleasant Hills, Thành phố Mandaluyong khỏi Trường Tiểu học Nuevo de Febrero và chuyển thành Trường Tiểu học Độc lập với tên gọi Trường Tiểu học Pleasant Hills, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Pleasant Hills ของโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Nuevo de Febrero ในบารังไกย์ Pleasant Hills เมือง Mandaluyong ออกจากโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Nuevo de Febrero และยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษาเอกเทศชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Pleasant Hills และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Pleasant Hills, Sekolah Dasar Nuevo de Febrero di Barangay Pleasant Hills, Kota Mandaluyong dari Sekolah Dasar Nuevo de Febrero dan menjadi Sekolah Dasar Mandiri dengan nama Sekolah Dasar Pleasant Hills, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Pleasant Hills, Sekolah Rendah Nuevo de Febrero di Barangay Pleasant Hills, Bandar Mandaluyong daripada Sekolah Rendah Nuevo de Febrero dan menjadi Sekolah Rendah Bebas dengan nama Sekolah Rendah Pleasant Hills, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Convertion into an Independent Elementary School. - The Nuevo de Febrero Elementary School-Pleasant Hills Annex in Barangay Pleasant Hills, City of Mandaluyong is hereby separated from Nuevo de Febrero Elementary School and converted into an independent elementary school to be known as the Pleasant Hills Elementary School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. - All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Nuevo de Febrero Elementary School-Pleasant Hills Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Pleasant Hills Elementary School.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Pleasant Hills Elementary School, the initial funding if which shall be charged against the current year's appropriations of the Nuevo de Febrero Elementary School-Pleasant Hills Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. - The Secretary of Education shall issue such rules and regulations as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
